title: Diakorp v6: diachronic corpus of Czech
notes: Diakorp v6 (~3.45M words, 116 documents, 14th-20th c., normalized transcriptions with original spellings) is officially deposited on LINDAT/CLARIAH-CZ with PID http://hdl.handle.net/11234/1-5413 (verified 200 on the LINDAT landing page), distributed in a CQP-vertical format (not TEI). The 7 collected texts (Kabátník's Cesta z Čech..., Komenský's Labyrint...) are among its 116 source documents. Licence CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Origin verbatim: 'Diakorp: Kabátník, Martin: Cesta z Čech do Jeruzaléma a Egypta (KapPr (1492)'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: Kučera, Řehořková, Stluka — Institute of the Czech National Corpus (ÚČNK), Charles University, Prague; deposited on LINDAT/CLARIAH-CZ
license_note: Includes CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Licences or rights differ by text, corpus or editorial layer; consult the source terms for the selected material.
